entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:1
segments: For everything there is a season, and a time for very purpose under heaven:

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:2
segments: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:3
segments: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:4
segments: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:5
segments: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:6
segments: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:7
segments: a time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:8
segments: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:9
segments: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboreth?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:10
segments: I have seen the travail which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised therewith.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:11
segments: He hath made everything beautiful in its time: also he hath set eternity in their heart, yet so that man cannot find out the work that God hath done from the beginning even to the end.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:12
segments: I know that there is nothing better for them, than to rejoice, and to do good so long as they live.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:13
segments: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:14
segments: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor anything taken from it; and God hath done it, that men should fear before him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:15
segments: That which is hath been long ago; and that which is to be hath long ago been: and God seeketh again that which is passed away.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:16
segments: And moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:17
segments: I said in my heart, God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:18
segments: I said in my heart, [It is] because of the sons of men, that God may prove them, and that they may see that they themselves are [but as] beasts.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:19
segments: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; and man hath no preeminence above the beasts: for all is vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:20
segments: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:21
segments: Who knoweth the spirit of man, whether it goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast, whether it goeth downward to the earth?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:22
segments: Wherefore I saw that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him [back] to see what shall be after him?
